# `edit.merge_by_distance`: Merge by distance

Welds vertices that lie closer together than a distance, closing seams between joined or mirrored parts.

- Category: edit
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(n log n) for the n vertices taking part (sorted uniform grid), plus the corners of affected faces
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: merge by distance, remove doubles, weld vertices, polyMergeVertex distance, weld

Each cluster of nearby vertices (chains weld together) becomes one vertex at the cluster's center, so open borders lying on each other zip into shared edges. The default distance (0.1 mm) welds only coincident vertices.

**Use for** after `scene.join` of parts that touch along open borders, after mirroring, and on imported meshes with split vertices (`diagnose` reports open boundaries). Keep the distance well below the smallest edge, or detail collapses.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `distance` | `Length` | `0.0001` | Vertices closer than this weld together. |
| `select` | `Selector \| null` | - | Vertices that may weld (edges and faces select their vertices); all when omitted. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"target":"panels"}
```

Result: `panels (o:9): welded 2 vertices into 2 others (0 faces collapsed)`
